words_to_learn.definition_en: to seek advice or information of
words_to_learn.definition_vi: tham khảo ý kiến, hỏi ý kiến (bác sĩ, chuyên gia)

examples.en: The doctor consulted with a specialist before writing a new prescription.
examples.vi: Vị bác sĩ đã hội chẩn/tham khảo ý kiến một bác sĩ chuyên khoa trước khi kê đơn thuốc mới.

examples.en: May I consult with you about a drug interaction case I have?
examples.vi: Tôi có thể tham khảo ý kiến của ông về một ca tương tác thuốc mà tôi đang gặp phải được không?

word_family.example: Beatrice consulted her pharmacist about the number of different medications she is taking.
Let me arrange a consultation with a specialist to discuss your heart problem and some possible medications.
This is a consultative process and you probably won't have a definitive answer immediately.

usage.tip: Có thể dùng trực tiếp 'consult + người' hoặc 'consult with + người'; chú ý phân biệt danh từ chỉ sự việc 'consultation' (buổi tư vấn/hội chẩn) và danh từ chỉ người 'consultant' (chuyên gia tư vấn).

extra_families.example: The pharmacy chain hired a healthcare consultant to streamline its inventory system.

srs_sentence.en: Patients should schedule a _____ with their physician before stopping any prescribed blood pressure medication.
srs_sentence.vi: Bệnh nhân nên đặt lịch tư vấn với bác sĩ của mình trước khi ngưng bất kỳ loại thuốc huyết áp được kê đơn nào.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to exercise authoritative or dominating influence over
words_to_learn.definition_vi: kiểm soát, khống chế, điều khiển

examples.en: To control the cost of this medication, you may get the generic version.
examples.vi: Để kiểm soát chi phí của loại thuốc này, bạn có thể mua thuốc gốc (generic) tương đương.

examples.en: Please take your medication every day to control your high blood pressure.
examples.vi: Vui lòng uống thuốc mỗi ngày để kiểm soát chứng huyết áp cao của bạn.

usage.tip: Cụm 'quality control' (kiểm soát chất lượng), 'under control' (trong tầm kiểm soát) và 'beyond our control' (ngoài tầm kiểm soát) rất hay gặp.

extra_families.example: Proper diet and daily insulin help diabetic patients control their blood sugar levels.
All pharmaceutical products undergo rigorous quality control before leaving the factory.
Certain strong painkillers are classified as controlled substances and require a special prescription.
Mild seasonal allergies are easily controllable with over-the-counter antihistamines.

srs_sentence.en: The pharmaceutical plant maintains strict temperature _____ in the warehouse where vaccines are stored.
srs_sentence.vi: Nhà máy dược phẩm duy trì việc kiểm soát nhiệt độ nghiêm ngặt trong nhà kho nơi lưu trữ vắc-xin.

words_to_learn.definition_en: suited or favorable to one's purpose; easy to reach

examples.en: Is this a convenient location for you to pick up your prescription?
examples.vi: Đây có phải là một địa điểm thuận tiện để bạn đến lấy thuốc theo đơn không?

examples.en: It is convenient to have a pharmacy right across the street from my doctor's office.
examples.vi: Thật tiện lợi khi có một hiệu thuốc ngay bên kia đường đối diện phòng khám bác sĩ của tôi.

word_family.example: The convenience of a 24-hour neighborhood pharmacy is not to be underestimated.
Many people shop there because of its convenient location.
The pharmacy is conveniently located on my way home from work.

structures: It is convenient (for sb) + to V
usage.tip: Không dùng người làm chủ ngữ của 'convenient' (SAI: I am convenient -> ĐÚNG: It is convenient for me); cụm 'conveniently located' và 'at your earliest convenience' là tủ TOEIC.

extra_families.example: If this appointment time is inconvenient for you, please call us to reschedule.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the temporary closure of the drive-through pharmacy.

srs_sentence.en: The new neighborhood drugstore is _____ located right next to the subway station.
srs_sentence.vi: Hiệu thuốc mới của khu phố tọa lạc tại một vị trí rất thuận tiện ngay cạnh ga tàu điện ngầm.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: phát hiện ra, dò tìm, nhận ra

examples.en: My doctor put me through some simple tests to detect if I have asthma.
examples.vi: Bác sĩ đã cho tôi làm một số xét nghiệm đơn giản để phát hiện xem tôi có bị hen suyễn hay không.

examples.en: I have to keep track of my sleep patterns to detect how many times I get up in the night.
examples.vi: Tôi phải theo dõi giấc ngủ của mình để phát hiện xem mình thức dậy bao nhiêu lần trong đêm.

word_family.example: The laboratory test detected the presence of medication in his blood.
Early detection of diseases usually means that medications can be more effective.
After he took his medication faithfully for a few months and exercised more, Jack's disease was no longer detectable.

usage.tip: Cụm 'early detection' (việc phát hiện sớm bệnh tật/lỗi) rất phổ biến trong các bài đọc về y học và kỹ thuật.

extra_families.example: Automated optical detectors inspect every pill bottle on the packaging line.

srs_sentence.en: The pharmacy's new software automatically alerts the pharmacist upon the _____ of a possible drug allergy.
srs_sentence.vi: Phần mềm mới của hiệu thuốc tự động cảnh báo dược sĩ ngay khi phát hiện khả năng dị ứng thuốc.

words_to_learn.definition_en: a contribution to an accomplishment, a result, or a process

examples.en: Taking medications as directed is an important factor in getting well.
examples.vi: Việc uống thuốc đúng theo chỉ dẫn là một yếu tố quan trọng giúp mau khỏi bệnh.

examples.en: Could my cat be a factor contributing to my asthma?
examples.vi: Liệu con mèo của tôi có thể là một yếu tố góp phần gây ra bệnh hen suyễn của tôi không?

structures: factor + into/in + N (tính đến yếu tố)
usage.tip: Danh từ 'factor' thường đi với giới từ 'in' (an important factor in getting well / a key factor in our decision).

extra_families.example: When calculating the dosage, the pediatrician factored in the child's age and weight.
Researchers used a factorial study design to test combinations of the two vitamins.

srs_sentence.en: Patient compliance with dosage instructions is a crucial _____ in the success of antibiotic therapy.
srs_sentence.vi: Sự tuân thủ của bệnh nhân đối với hướng dẫn liều dùng là một yếu tố then chốt trong sự thành công của liệu pháp kháng sinh.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: sự tương tác (giữa các loại thuốc, hoặc giữa người với người)

examples.en: My pharmacist was concerned about the interaction of the two medications I was prescribed.
examples.vi: Dược sĩ của tôi lo ngại về sự tương tác của hai loại thuốc mà tôi đã được kê đơn.

examples.en: The interaction between the patient and the doctor showed a high level of trust.
examples.vi: Sự tương tác giữa bệnh nhân và bác sĩ cho thấy một mức độ tin tưởng cao.

usage.tip: Trong ngữ cảnh nhà thuốc, 'drug interaction' là 'tương tác thuốc' (khi hai loại thuốc phản ứng với nhau); động từ gốc là 'interact with'.

extra_families.example: Certain herbal supplements can interact negatively with prescription blood thinners.
The pharmacy website features an interactive tool for checking medication side effects.
Pharmacists train interactively using computer simulations of patient consultations.

srs_sentence.en: Always inform your pharmacist about any vitamins you take to avoid harmful drug _____.
srs_sentence.vi: Hãy luôn thông báo cho dược sĩ về bất kỳ loại vitamin nào bạn đang uống để tránh các tương tác thuốc có hại.

words_to_learn.definition_en: the point beyond which something cannot proceed
words_to_learn.definition_vi: giới hạn, hạn mức; giới hạn lại

examples.en: My prescription has a limit of three refills.
examples.vi: Đơn thuốc của tôi có giới hạn là ba lần mua lặp lại (refills).

examples.en: My health plan authorization sets a limit on which health care providers I can see without their permission.
examples.vi: Giấy phép bảo hiểm y tế của tôi đặt ra giới hạn về những nhà cung cấp dịch vụ chăm sóc sức khỏe nào tôi có thể đến khám mà không cần xin phép họ.

word_family.example: My health insurance company has severely limited the amount of money it will pay out for prescription medicine.
Even though that headache medicine does not require a prescription, there is a limit to how many times a day you should take it.
The new drugstore on the corner really isn't convenient because of its limited hours of operation.

usage.tip: Cụm 'set/impose a limit ON sth' (đặt giới hạn lên cái gì) và 'limit A to B' (giới hạn A ở mức B) xuất hiện rất thường xuyên.

extra_families.example: Please review the policy booklet for a full list of coverage limitations.
Members of the premium wellness plan enjoy unlimited telephone consultations with nurses.

srs_sentence.en: To prevent shortages, the pharmacy has _____ purchases of cold medicine to two boxes per customer.
srs_sentence.pos_hint: động từ chia quá khứ phân từ V3/ed (hiện tại hoàn thành)
srs_sentence.vi: Để ngăn ngừa tình trạng khan hiếm, hiệu thuốc đã giới hạn việc mua thuốc cảm cúm ở mức hai hộp mỗi khách hàng.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: theo dõi sát sao, giám sát; màn hình, thiết bị theo dõi

examples.en: The nurse practitioner carefully monitors the number of medications her patients are taking.
examples.vi: Y tá thực hành theo dõi cẩn thận số lượng các loại thuốc mà bệnh nhân của cô đang dùng.

examples.en: The patient had weekly appointments so that the doctor could monitor her progress.
examples.vi: Bệnh nhân có các cuộc hẹn hàng tuần để bác sĩ có thể theo dõi sự tiến triển của cô.

usage.tip: Thường đi kèm các trạng từ như 'closely', 'carefully', 'regularly', 'constantly' (closely monitor the patient's condition).

extra_families.example: Doctors must closely monitor patients who are starting this new cardiac medication.
The pharmacy sells digital blood pressure monitors for home use.
Regular blood glucose monitoring is essential for managing diabetes effectively.

srs_sentence.en: The clinical pharmacist is responsible for _____ patients' lab values to ensure the dosage remains safe.
srs_sentence.pos_hint: danh động từ V-ing (sau giới từ for)
srs_sentence.vi: Dược sĩ lâm sàng chịu trách nhiệm theo dõi các chỉ số xét nghiệm của bệnh nhân để đảm bảo liều lượng thuốc luôn an toàn.

words_to_learn.definition_en: capable of being but not yet in existence; possible
words_to_learn.definition_vi: tiềm năng, có khả năng xảy ra; tiềm lực

examples.en: To avoid any potential side effects from the medication, be sure to tell your doctor all the drugs you are currently taking.
examples.vi: Để tránh bất kỳ tác dụng phụ tiềm ẩn nào từ thuốc, hãy chắc chắn nói với bác sĩ tất cả các loại thuốc bạn hiện đang dùng.

examples.en: Given the potential delay in getting reimbursed by the health plan, why don't we just fill one prescription today?
examples.vi: Trước nguy cơ chậm trễ tiềm ẩn trong việc được chương trình bảo hiểm hoàn tiền, tại sao hôm nay chúng ta không lấy trước một đơn thuốc thôi?

word_family.example: Be careful when taking this medication because it has the potential to make you feel sleepy.
Margaret decided not to take the medicine the doctor had prescribed because of its potential side effects.
Many medications are potentially dangerous so it is important to take them exactly as prescribed by the doctor.

structures: the potential + for + N / to V
usage.tip: 'Potential' vừa là tính từ (potential side effects/clients) vừa là danh từ không đếm được (have the potential to V / reach one's full potential).

extra_families.example: Combining these two analgesics can potentiate their pain-relieving effects.

srs_sentence.en: Because this antibiotic is _____ harmful if taken with alcohol, a warning label is affixed to the bottle.
srs_sentence.pos_hint: trạng từ (bổ nghĩa cho tính từ harmful)
srs_sentence.vi: Vì loại kháng sinh này có khả năng gây hại nếu uống cùng rượu bia, một nhãn cảnh báo đã được dán lên lọ thuốc.

words_to_learn.definition_en: a portion, piece, or segment that is representative of a whole
words_to_learn.definition_vi: mẫu thử, mẫu xét nghiệm; dùng thử, lấy mẫu

examples.en: The pharmacist gave Myra a few free samples of the allergy medication.
examples.vi: Người dược sĩ đã đưa cho Myra một vài mẫu dùng thử miễn phí của loại thuốc trị dị ứng.

examples.en: A sample of the population taking the new medicine was surveyed to determine whether it caused side effects.
examples.vi: Một mẫu đại diện trong nhóm dân số đang dùng loại thuốc mới đã được khảo sát để xác định xem thuốc có gây tác dụng phụ hay không.

usage.tip: Vừa mang nghĩa 'mẫu hàng dùng thử miễn phí' (free samples), vừa mang nghĩa 'mẫu xét nghiệm/khảo sát' (blood sample / a sample of the population).

extra_families.example: Quality inspectors randomly sample batches of tablets from the production line.
Random sampling showed that ninety-eight percent of patients were satisfied with the pharmacy.

srs_sentence.en: The dermatologist gave the patient several complimentary _____ of the medicated skin cream to try at home.
srs_sentence.vi: Bác sĩ da liễu đã đưa cho bệnh nhân một vài mẫu dùng thử miễn phí của loại kem bôi da đặc trị để thử ở nhà.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: cảm nhận, sự phán đoán, ý thức; cảm thấy, nhận biết

examples.en: The doctor had a good sense about what the problem was but wanted to get a second opinion.
examples.vi: Vị bác sĩ có phán đoán/cảm nhận khá tốt về vấn đề là gì nhưng vẫn muốn có thêm ý kiến chuyên môn thứ hai.

examples.en: I got the sense it would be better to get my prescription filled right away.
examples.vi: Tôi có cảm giác rằng sẽ tốt hơn nếu đi lấy thuốc theo đơn ngay lập tức.

structures: get/have the sense + that + S + V
usage.tip: Phân biệt hai tính từ cùng gốc rất hay bẫy trong TOEIC: 'sensible' (hợp lý, khôn ngoan) và 'sensitive' (nhạy cảm).

extra_families.example: The pharmacist sensed that the elderly customer was confused about the dosage schedule.
Keeping a written list of all your current medications is a sensible precaution.
This liquid antibiotic is sensitive to heat and must be kept in the refrigerator.

srs_sentence.en: It is a _____ practice to keep all prescription medications in their original labeled containers.
srs_sentence.pos_hint: tính từ (mang nghĩa hợp lý, khôn ngoan)
srs_sentence.vi: Việc giữ tất cả các loại thuốc kê đơn trong lọ đựng có dán nhãn ban đầu của chúng là một thói quen hợp lý.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: tình nguyện, tự nguyện làm; tình nguyện viên

examples.en: My doctor volunteered to call the drugstore, so my medication would be waiting for me.
examples.vi: Bác sĩ của tôi đã tự nguyện gọi điện cho hiệu thuốc để thuốc của tôi sẽ được chuẩn bị sẵn sàng chờ tôi đến lấy.

examples.en: Since Tom was feeling so unwell, his son volunteered to pick up his prescription at the pharmacy for him.
examples.vi: Vì Tom cảm thấy quá mệt, con trai ông đã tình nguyện đi lấy thuốc theo đơn ở hiệu thuốc giúp ông.

word_family.example: The pharmacist volunteers his services monthly at the free clinic for homeless people.
Volunteers bring filled prescriptions from the pharmacy to the homes of shut-ins.
Your compliance with this new policy is completely voluntary, but we think it is in the public interest that you do so.

usage.tip: Đi với 'to V' (volunteer to V: tình nguyện làm gì); tính từ là 'voluntary' (tự nguyện) và trạng từ là 'voluntarily'.

extra_families.example: The manufacturer voluntarily recalled one lot of eye drops as a safety precaution.

srs_sentence.en: Over two hundred healthy adults _____ participated in the clinical study for the new allergy nasal spray.
srs_sentence.vi: Hơn hai trăm người trưởng thành khỏe mạnh đã tự nguyện tham gia vào nghiên cứu lâm sàng cho loại thuốc xịt mũi trị dị ứng mới.

words_in_context.passage: Read the following passage and write the words in the blanks below. Yoko is having trouble with seasonal allergies this fall. After (1) ____ with her doctor, they decide she should take medication on a regular basis to (2) ____ her symptoms. Her doctor recommends the medication he thinks will work best and offers her a handful of (3) ____ at no charge. For her long-term needs, Yoko will need to have a prescription filled. Her doctor (4) ____ to call the pharmacy Yoko uses to order a supply, which will (5) ____ the time she spends waiting for the prescription to be filled. Yoko is new in town and does not know which pharmacy she wants to use. She knows that there is a drugstore near her apartment and one near where she works, but does not remember the operating hours for either. Yoko knows that (6) ____ hours and location are important (7) ____ in selecting a pharmacy. Although she can fill different prescriptions at different drugstores, it makes more (8) ____ to Yoko to fill all of her medications at one location. Occasionally, some drugs will have harmful (9) ____. Usually, your doctor will prevent a drug interaction problem before it starts. But, if you see more than one doctor, it is hard to (10) ____ the various medications you are taking. Having all your prescriptions filled at one location increases the chances that the pharmacist will detect a (11) ____ drug interaction problem. This timely (12) ____ can save your life.

My health insurance company has severely limited the amount of money it will pay out for prescription medicine.

Be careful when taking this medication because it has the potential to make you feel sleepy.

Your prescription will be ready in an hour, if that's ____ for you.

part6.passage: Cloverdale Pharmacy The neighborhood pharmacy that you can rely on! Cloverdale is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Unlike other pharmacies with limited schedules, we're open all the time. You can rely on us in an emergency at any time of day. And, our schedule makes it [16] for busy working people to fill prescriptions after work or on weekends. You're always safe with us! When you fill a prescription at Cloverdale, we keep a careful record. This way, we can easily [17] the medications you are taking and inform you of any potentially harmful interactions. Do you need help selecting over-the-counter medications? Our pharmacists are available to [18] with you and help you choose the medications that suit your needs. Cloverdale Pharmacy. We're here to serve you.

part7.text: Questions 19–23 refer to the following article. Many people don't realize that their pharmacist is an important member of their health care team. If you always fill you prescriptions at the same pharmacy, then you will have a pharmacist who is familiar with your medical issues and can detect any possible problems with your medications. In fact, it is a good idea to volunteer information about medications you are already taking when you visit a new pharmacist. Then, she can add this information to your records and have a complete file of information. She can monitor the drugs you are taking and let you know of any potential interactions or harmful side effects. If cost is an issue for you, your pharmacist can help. Ask her if there are any less expensive brands of your medication available. Or, you can request that she fill only half the prescription, to give you a chance to try out the medication before paying for the entire amount. You can also ask your doctor for a few free samples. Once you have ascertained that the prescribed medication is working for you, you can go ahead and ask your pharmacist to fill the prescription for you. When you pick up your prescription, don't forget to ask the pharmacist to explain to you how to take it if you have any doubts. She can also supply you with written instructions. Your pharmacist can provide you with important support, but there is a limit to what she can do. If you suspect that you have a problem that requires medical attention, you should always consult your doctor right away. 22. The word detect in line 4 is closest in meaning to (A) repair (B) create (C) inform (D) discover 23. The word potential in line 8 is closest in meaning to (A) common (B) interesting (C) dangerous (D) possible

## Pharmacy

Study the following definitions and examples.

1. consult v., to seek advice or information of

a. The doctor consulted with a specialist before writing a new prescription.

b. May I consult with you about a drug interaction case I have?

2. control v., to exercise authoritative or dominating influence over

a. To control the cost of this medication, you may get the generic version.

b. Please take your medication every day to control your high blood pressure.

3. convenient adj., suited or favorable to one's purpose; easy to reach

a. Is this a convenient location for you to pick up your prescription?

b. It is convenient to have a pharmacy right across the street from my doctor's office.

4. detect v., to discover or ascertain

a. My doctor put me through some simple tests to detect if I have asthma.

b. I have to keep track of my sleep patterns to detect how many times I get up in the night.

5. factor n., a contribution to an accomplishment, a result, or a process

a. Taking medications as directed is an important factor in getting well.

b. Could my cat be a factor contributing to my asthma?

6. interaction n., a mutual activity

a. My pharmacist was concerned about the interaction of the two medications I was prescribed.

b. The interaction between the patient and the doctor showed a high level of trust.

7. limit n., the point beyond which something cannot proceed

a. My prescription has a limit of three refills.

b. My health plan authorization sets a limit on which health care providers I can see without their permission.

8. monitor v., to keep track of

a. The nurse practitioner carefully monitors the number of medications her patients are taking.

b. The patient had weekly appointments so that the doctor could monitor her progress.

9. potential adj., capable of being but not yet in existence; possible

a. To avoid any potential side effects from the medication, be sure to tell your doctor all the drugs you are currently taking.

b. Given the potential delay in getting reimbursed by the health plan, why don't we just fill one prescription today?

10. sample n., a portion, piece, or segment that is representative of a whole a. The pharmacist gave Myra a few free samples of the allergy medication.

b. A sample of the population taking the new medicine was surveyed to determine whether it caused side effects.

11. sense n., a judgment; an intellectual interpretation

a. The doctor had a good sense about what the problem was but wanted to get a second opinion.

b. I got the sense it would be better to get my prescription filled right away.

12. volunteer v., to perform as a volunteer

a. My doctor volunteered to call the drugstore, so my medication would be waiting for me.

b. Since Tom was feeling so unwell, his son volunteered to pick up his prescription at the pharmacy for him.

## Part 7 Reading Comprehension

Questions 19–23 refer to the following article.

Many people don't realize that their pharmacist is an important member of their health care team. If you always fill you prescriptions at the same pharmacy, then you will have a pharmacist who is familiar with your medical issues and can detect any possible problems with your medications. In fact, it is a good idea to volunteer information about medications you are already taking when you visit a new pharmacist. Then, she can add this information to your records and have a complete file of information. She can monitor the drugs you are taking and let you know of any potential interactions or harmful side effects.

If cost is an issue for you, your pharmacist can help. Ask her if there are any less expensive brands of your medication available. Or, you can request that she fill only half the prescription, to give you a chance to try out the medication before paying for the entire amount. You can also ask your doctor for a few free samples. Once you have ascertained that the prescribed medication is working for you, you can go ahead and ask your pharmacist to fill the prescription for you. When you pick up your prescription, don't forget to ask the pharmacist to explain to you how to take it if you have any doubts. She can also supply you with written instructions.

Your pharmacist can provide you with important support, but there is a limit to what she can do. If you suspect that you have a problem that requires medical attention, you should always consult your doctor right away.
